Replaced the lossy OTLP export path with prometheus_client.push_to_gateway(). Commits 6378cbc (subagent impl) + 6689732 (env-var-name fix). Grouping key uses {code_location, job_name, step_key} from DAGSTER_CODE_LOCATION / DAGSTER_RUN_JOB_NAME / DAGSTER_RUN_STEP_KEY — the env vars dagster_k8s.executor actually injects. Added PROMETHEUS_PUSHGATEWAY_URL env var to all 5 code location deployment yamls. Root cause was that push_metrics() was converting every metric family (Counter, Histogram, Gauge) to a Gauge — destroying histogram bucket semantics — and skipping zero-value samples which dropped fresh histogram buckets entirely. 8 new tests in libs/dagster-io/tests/test_metrics_push.py covering happy path + exception safety + scheme stripping + env var fallbacks.
